purpose: Creative-planning input for a new Moonroot WP-03P-A scene. It prevents familiar fantasy motifs from being repeatedly relocated between units; it is not an automatic image-quality filter.
procedure: Before staging a new scene, read every earlier scene entry and select underused semantic families for its five transformations per site.
Put the relevant prior families and close synonyms in that scene inventory's avoidRecurringMotifs field so every Gemini request receives them.
Do a text-only duplicate-idea pass across all fifty planned transformations before paid generation.
After staging, record the new scene's planned families here; after owner review, mark which families were actually retained.
